path_basis.corpus_manifest: Paths in data/corpus_manifest.json are relative to the project root.
path_basis.formal_package: B sets data_dir to data/formal_corpus and reads data/formal_corpus/manifest.json. A path starting with data/ drops that first segment and resolves inside data_dir.

version_algorithm.digest: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON encoded as UTF-8

material.documents: sorted by document_id; fields: document_id, title, issuer, source_url, published_at, effective_at, raw_sha256, text_sha256, structure_sha256

version_algorithm.structure_sha256: digest of the adapted articles array, including label, chapter, and section
version_algorithm.accepted_structure_json_sha256: SHA-256 of the accepted data/processed JSON file bytes

documents.title: Directive 2011/83/EU of the European Parliament and of the Council of 25 October 2011 on consumer rights, amending Council Directive 93/13/EEC and Directive 1999/44/EC of the European Parliament and of the Council and repealing Council Directive 85/577/EEC and Directive 97/7/EC of the European Parliament and of the Council Text with EEA relevance

cleaning_rules.whitespace: Each block is one line. Whitespace inside a block, including NBSP, collapses to a single space. Major parts are separated by one blank line. The file ends with one LF.
cleaning_rules.sentence_spacing: A missing space after a lowercase letter or digit and before an uppercase letter is restored. This repairs text nodes split by inline boxes.
cleaning_rules.footnotes: In-text note anchors render as (n). The note remains at its position and records the blocks that cite it.
cleaning_rules.lists: Two-column layout tables render as 'marker text' lines.
cleaning_rules.tables: oj-table rows render as cells joined by ' | ', and empty cells stay in place.
cleaning_rules.main_articles: A main article is a div.eli-subdivision whose id is art_<number> and whose parent is not an annex. Quoted article headings and annex correlation cells are not main articles.
cleaning_rules.excluded: Navigation, language selection, search, cookies, download controls, the page table of contents, the duplicate EUR-Lex title, and the Official Journal running header.
cleaning_rules.character_offsets: Python character indexes into the complete cleaned text, using [start, end). Not UTF-8 bytes or model tokens. Positions are recorded during assembly.

cleaning_rules.footnotes: A p.note with an ntr definition anchor starts a footnote. A continuation p.note without a new definition anchor is merged into the previous footnote. The citation relationship and the full text are kept. In this file, 6 p.note elements correspond to 4 footnotes.
